MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits my battery-holder, relay, and circuit-board projects because it would help insulate wire connections, provided the diameter fits.",
    "The digital calipers connect to a practical need in my electronics work: measuring small components and checking mounting dimensions. I would choose the NEIKO for that purpose this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge and water-testing meters measure things, but neither addresses the component dimensions or wiring tasks I have in mind.",
    "Filament and adhesives need a specific printing or bonding project to be useful to me, and I do not currently have one.",
    "The caster wheels relate to a previous purchase, but I do not need another set now, especially with a different size and mounting arrangement. The second caliper is relevant but duplicates the one I would choose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been taken as interest in a broad range of workshop supplies, even when their actual uses differ from my projects.",
    "A previous caster purchase seems to have been treated as a continuing need for wheels, although that purchase may already have met the need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The strongest connection across my battery holder, breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay is assembling small electronic circuits; supplies that directly support those tasks feel most useful.",
    "Compatibility and an immediate purpose matter: tubing must fit my wiring, replacement wheels must suit the mounting, and two calipers would serve the same need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics work but stretched that interest into workshop supplies without enough connection to a current task."
}
